title: Factoring a trinomial
subject: Math
learningGoal: Factor x² + bx + c by finding two numbers that multiply to c and add to b.
spokenLines: Take x squared plus five x plus six.
We want two numbers that multiply to six...
Two and three work — two times three is six, two plus three is five.
So we factor it as x plus two, times x plus three.
Quick check: expand it and you get back x squared plus five x plus six.
